title: 7.1 My Body
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Name the body from head to feet: Esta es mi cabeza. Tengo dos ojos.
grammar_function: Este/Esta es mi + body part; Tengo + number + body parts.
speaking_outcome: Name the body from head to feet: Esta es mi cabeza. Tengo dos ojos.
